name: shrooms_core
description: Talks to a Shrooms daemon over its unix control socket: reads status and the recent log, and changes what the daemon can change on its own — name, node mode, published services per mesh, announcing them, blind relays, the domain names answer under, repeating revocations, meshes on and off, joining a mesh with an invite (on a thread of its own, since it waits for the other device), leaving one, and restarting to apply the settings that need it. Never who is admitted, which needs an admin key the daemon has never held (ADR-025). Exists because a ui_qml app is sandboxed and may not open a socket; this runs in its own process and can.
